'''Urbak''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] assigned to the engineering staff onboard the [[Admiral Ackbar (Victory-class)|''Admiral Ackbar'']] during the [[Battle of the Murgo Choke|blockade]] of the [[Murgo Choke]].

Captain Urbak was killed by Gorog assassins when the [[Gorog|Dark Nest]] attacked the ships of the [[Fifth Fleet (Galactic Alliance)|Galactic Alliance Fifth Fleet]]. Lieutenant [[Reo]] was also [[Death/Legends|killed]], leaving Captain [[Yuul]] to assume responsibility for the engineering section.
